zbx <version>, run "web-1"

redaction: OFF (--no-redact): secrets are in this bundle as they were
review every file before you share this bundle; zbx never uploads it

files:
  MANIFEST.txt
    this list
  run-record.zon (664 bytes)
    the run's record: name, rootfs, command, labels, times, how it ended
  version.txt (36 bytes)
    the zbx version and how it was built
  mapping.txt (30 bytes)
    how ids were mapped into the container, and who ran zbx
  uname.txt (35 bytes)
    the kernel release and machine (not the host name)
  os-release.txt (47 bytes)
    the distribution
  cgroup.txt (49 bytes)
    the cgroup layout of the zbx process
  environment.txt (122 bytes)
    the environment variables of zbx; values are redacted unless --no-redact
  doctor.json (2154 bytes)
    the host checks of `zbx doctor`, one JSON object per line
